item.title: Mississippi reflects the nation regarding jobs
item.description: The boom in manufacturing jobs President Donald Trump forecast last April has yet to loom much yet boom. “Manufacturers shed workers in each of the eight months after Trump unveiled ‘Liberation Day’ tariffs,” the Wall Street Journal reported this month.

item.title: Downtown History Walk set for Feb. 28
item.description: Probably one of the most popular documented stories about Meridian’s history is “The Last Two Men Hanged at the Lauderdale County Jail.”

item.title: Lauderdale County in talks for second data center investment
item.description: Lauderdale County residents may soon see construction in the Sonny Montgomery Industrial Park as talks are underway to bring a second data center to the area.

item.title: Meridian’s Duncan receives Paraoptometric Community Service award
item.description: Meridianite Brandie Duncan of Primary Eyesore and Optical of Meridian is the Mississippi Optometric Association’s 2025 Paraoptometric Community Service award recipient, the organization announced Saturday. The award is presented annually recognizing significant contributions to the profession of optometry and the public.

item.title: Meridian Community College golfer Reaux looks to continue momentum after tournament win
item.description: Golf has become a world of opportunities for Dax Reaux. Now in his sophomore year at Meridian Community College, even the school's head golf coach Lance Strickland sees a bright future for the 19-year-old in some capacity in the sport.

item.title: Balanced scoring keys EMCC to 84-77 home win over Delta; Lady Lions fall 54-47 to Lady Trojans
item.description: Balanced scoring paced the East Mississippi Community College men’s basketball team to a second straight conference victory with an 84-77 home win over Mississippi Delta during Thursday’s MACCC hoops action played at Keyes T. Currie Coliseum.

item.title: Week 6 legislative roundup
item.description: The sixth week of the 2026 Regular Session has concluded. The House continued advancing major legislation as key floor deadlines approached, taking up measures related to public safety, healthcare, education funding and disaster response.

item.title: Meridian Basketball Coach Wheaton named to Tomorrow 25 Fellowship
item.description: Meridian High School Boys Assistant Basketball Coach Kenton Wheaton is the latest in a long line of MHS coaches to be named to the Tomorrow’s 25 Coaching Fellowship.
